scripts.text:
[Thug]
*Sigh...*
What is life?
And what use
is money? ...Damn.
Damn this worthless life!
scripts.translation:
[惡棍]
*Sigh...*
人生算什麼？
錢又有什麼用？
...該死。
這破爛人生，真他媽該死！

scripts.text:
[Thug]
Hey, kid.
What the hell
are you lookin' at?
scripts.translation:
[惡棍]
喂，小鬼。
你他媽看什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Thug]
Then get the
hell out of my face!
Didn't you hear me?
Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[惡棍]
那就滾出我的視線！
沒聽到嗎？
滾蛋！

scripts.text:
[Thug]
Hmmm...
Maybe I'll swing by the ^0000FFRogue Guild^000000 in ^0000FFParos Lighthouse^000000...
scripts.translation:
[惡棍]
嗯...
也許該去^0000FF流氓公會^000000逛逛，就在^0000FF帕羅斯燈塔^000000...

scripts.text:
[Thug]
I needz my money,
and they best have it...
scripts.translation:
[惡棍]
老子得拿到錢，他們最好準備好了...

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Eh? You...you...?!
Hey, haven't we met before?
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
咦？你...你...？！
喂，咱們是不是見過？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
..............
Awww, ^FF0000I am sorry^000000! I think I misunderstood you from someone I know.

[Markie]
I never misunderstand people...oh well, be safe anyway!
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
我從來不會認錯人...算了，總之祝你平安！

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Yo, what are you doin'?!
You can't change your job if you got unused skill points, so use 'em all up. You bettah check yo-self before you wreck yo-self.
scripts.translation:
[流氓公會成員]
喲，搞什麼呢？！
還有沒用完的技能點就不能轉職，趕緊都用掉。
先檢查清楚，省得自己搞砸。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
So what's a kid
like you doin' here?
Oh, I get it now...
The widdle boy wants
to be a ^800000Rogue^000000.
scripts.translation:
[流氓公會成員]
你這小鬼來這裡幹什麼？
哦，懂了...
小男孩想當^800000流氓^000000啊。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
So what's a kid
like you doin' here?
Oh, I see...
Lil' cutie wants 
to be a ^800000Rogue^000000.
scripts.translation:
[流氓公會成員]
你這小鬼來這裡幹什麼？
哦，懂了...
小可愛想當^800000流氓^000000啊。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Eh, nice meetin' you, I guess. I'm Markie, and I do work for the Rogue Guild, a philanthro-- *ahem* a ^800000feelanthropist^000000 group, as you can see. So what's your name?
scripts.translation:
[流氓公會成員]
呃，算是很高興認識你吧。
我叫馬基，替流氓公會做事。
我們是個慈善——*ahem* 是個^800000慈善家^000000團體嘛，你也看到了。
你叫什麼？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
...{0}?
Heh heh! Cool name.
If it was dorky, we'd
make you change it,
so you're in luck.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
...{0}？
Heh heh! 名字挺酷。
要是太土，我們就得讓你改名了，算你走運。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
So why you wanna join up with the Rogues? I guess you gave me your real name, so you'd be an honest Rogue. Not many of those around, heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
怎麼想來當流氓？
你報的應該是真名吧，看來還挺老實。
老實的流氓可不多，heh heh~

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Rule number 1 for Rogues...
Never give out your real identity to most people, most of the time. It's just a little backup measure we like to use.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
流氓的第一條規矩...
一般情況下，別隨便向人透露真實身份。
這算是我們給自己留的一條後路。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Right. I'm officially accepting your application, so now you gotta take a test. Don't sweat it, this first one is real simple.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
好，你的申請正式受理了，現在得參加考核。
別緊張，第一關簡單得很。

[馬基]
好的...
讓我們開始吧！

scripts.text:
[Markie]
You again?
Okay, you probably screwed up last time 'cuz you were way too nervous. So just chill and pass
this test, okay?
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
又是你？
上次大概是太緊張，才搞砸了吧。
放鬆點，這次把考核過了，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Go talk to Smith. His test might be pretty hard. He's one of the guys who makes sure that people pay up their debts to us. So yeah, he might be a bit of a hard case.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
去找史密斯吧。
他的考核可能挺難。
他專門負責催人還清欠我們的債，所以可能有點難對付。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Yeah...
That guy can be pretty anal, but we need a guy like him in our guild. Anyway, be careful. Lots of luck to you, pal.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
是啊...
那傢伙特別愛較真，不過公會也需要這種人。
總之，小心點。
祝你好運，夥計。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Heh heh...
Fresh meat. This'll be
a cinch to--Wait! Er, I wasn't talkin' about you! I meant the other fresh meat~
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
Heh heh...
新來的肥羊，這下可好——等等！
呃，我可不是說你！
我說的是別的肥羊~

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Oh hey, it's you!
You did a good job, guy.
Now, lemme change your
job to Rogue. You earned it!
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
哦，是你啊！
幹得不錯，夥計。
現在就讓你轉職成流氓，這是你應得的！

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Oh! It's you!
You were actually able to put up with that guy? Good stuff! Must've had a rough time collect all those items, eh?
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
哦，是你！
居然能忍得了那傢伙？
有你的！
收集那些東西夠辛苦的吧？

[馬基]
恭喜~！
你這模樣酷斃了！

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Hey hey~
Congrats!
You've been
doin' a great job~
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
Hey hey~
恭喜！
你表現得很棒~

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Now...
It's time
for me to make
a speech~ *Ahem*
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
現在...
該我發表一番講話了~ *Ahem*

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Enjoy your freedom as a Rogue. Just remember that you gotta be free and responsible at the same time. So treat other guys the way you wanna be treated, kay? Alright, seeya round.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
好好享受當流氓的自由吧。
不過記住，自由歸自由，該負的責任也得負。
想讓別人怎麼待你，就怎麼待別人，懂了？
好，回頭見。

scripts.text: Hold on, I need to get ready!

[Markie]
Get ready...?
Fine, fine.
Take your sweet
time, why don't you?
But hurry up and
come back, got it?
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
還要準備...？
行，行，你還真是不著急啊。
不過趕緊回來，聽見沒？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Listen carefully, and
pick the right answer.
Capish? Now, lemme
read these questions...
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
仔細聽，選出正確答案。
懂了沒？
來，我念題了...

scripts.text:
[Markie]
1. Choose the skill necessary for learning ^880000Stalk^000000.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
1. 選擇學習^880000潛遁^000000所需的技能。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
2. In comparison to the Merchant's Level 10 ^880000Discount^000000 skill, how much more of a discount, in terms of percent, can a Rogue get with Level 10 ^880000Haggle^000000 skill?
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
2. 和商人的10級^880000低價買進^000000相比，流氓的10級^880000強制減價^000000能多便宜幾個百分點？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
3. What is the correct description for the skill, ^880000Mug^000000?
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
3. 關於技能^880000偷錢^000000，下列描述正確的是？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
4. How many Rogues does it require to activate the skill, ^880000Slyness^000000?
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
4. 發動技能^880000流氓天國^000000需要幾名流氓？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
5. Choose the skill that you can learn at Level 5 ^880000Divest Helm^000000.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
5. 學會5級^880000卸除頭盔^000000後，可以學習哪個技能？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
6. Choose the skill which allows its user to move while hiding.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
6. 哪個技能能讓使用者在隱匿狀態下移動？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
7. Choose the card that increases the accuracy rate of its owner.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
7. 哪張卡片能提高命中率？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
8. Choose the monster that receives more damage when it's attacked by a weapon with the Vadon card (20 % more damage on Fire property).
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
8. 用插有螃蟹卡片的武器攻擊，以下哪種魔物會受到額外傷害？
（對火屬性魔物的傷害增加20%。）

scripts.text:
[Markie]
9. How much SP does the skill ^880000Double Attack^000000 require when used with a Dagger?
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
9. 使用短劍時，^880000二刀連擊^000000消耗多少 SP？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
10. Choose the most efficient dagger to use in the Byalan Dungeon.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
10. 在拜蘭地下城使用哪種短劍最有效？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
1. Which monster drops a slotted Gladius?
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
1. 哪種魔物會掉落有插槽的長柄短劍？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
2. Which monster drops a slotted Main-Gauche?
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
2. 哪種魔物會掉落有插槽的笨拙短劍？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
3. Choose the class that is able to create unique potions.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
3. 哪個職業能製作特殊藥劑？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
4. Choose the weapon that Rogues aren't allowed to use.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
4. 哪種武器是流氓不能使用的？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
5. Choose the property that the monster Hode possesses.

[Markie]
6. Choose the monster that is unable to be tamed for as a Cute Pet.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
6. 哪種魔物不能馴養成寵物？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
7. Choose the monster that receives more damage from a Dagger with the Fire property.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
7. 以下哪種魔物受到火屬性短劍攻擊時，傷害會更高？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
8. Choose the town that doesn't have any guild castles.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
8. 哪個城鎮沒有公會城堡？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
9. Choose the plant that drops Blue Herbs.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
9. 哪種植物會掉落藍色藥草？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
10. Choose the monster that does not have the Undead property.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
10. 以下哪種魔物不是不死屬性？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
1. By what percentage is the flee rate increased when a Thief masters the ^880000Improve Dodge^000000?
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
1. 盜賊將^880000殘影^000000學滿後，迴避率提高百分之多少？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
2. Choose the monster that detects a characters using the Hiding or Cloaking skill.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
2. 哪種魔物能發現使用隱匿或偽裝的角色？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
3. Choose the location where Thieves can change their jobs to Rogues.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
3. 盜賊在哪裡可以轉職為流氓？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
4. In which town can Novices change their jobs to Thieves?
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
4. 初心者在哪個城鎮可以轉職為盜賊？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
5. Choose the card that does not affect the DEX stat.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
5. 哪張卡片不會影響 DEX？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
6. So what's cool about being a Rogue?
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
6. 當流氓有什麼酷的？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
7. When is it possible to change jobs from Thief to Rogue?
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
7. 什麼時候可以從盜賊轉職為流氓？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
8. You want to dye your hair blue. What town do you go to, and in which direction, with 12 o' clock being North.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
8. 想把頭髮染成藍色，該去哪個城鎮的哪個方向？
以12點鐘方向為北。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
9. Choose the mushroom that is required on the Thief job change quest.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
9. 盜賊轉職任務中需要哪種蘑菇？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
10. Choose the card that least benefits the Rogue class.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
10. 哪張卡片對流氓的幫助最小？

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Let's see.
You got...
{0} points.
Good. You passed.
We don't gotta
do that again.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
讓我看看。
你得了...{0}分。
不錯，通過了。
不用再考一遍了。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Let's see.
You got...
{0} points.
Aw crud... You failed!
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
讓我看看。
你得了...{0}分。
嘖，糟了...沒通過！

scripts.text:
[Markie]
But don't get too comfortable just yet, you got more o' these tests. Your next one will be from Smith.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
先別高興得太早，後面還有考核。
下一關找史密斯。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
So...
Go find Smith and finish up this test, yeah? Be careful though, Smith's a pretty anal guy.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
所以...
去找史密斯，把考核完成吧？
不過小心點，那傢伙特別愛較真。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Man, you shoulda learned more when you had the chance. Thanks for wasting my time.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
夥計，有機會的時候就該多學點。
真是謝謝你，白白浪費我的時間。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
*Sigh...* Lemme give you some tips, yeah? I'm supposed to tell you about some kind of ^990000iro.ragnarokonline.com^000000 to help you learn what you need to know.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
*Sigh...* 給你點提示吧？
上頭讓我告訴你什麼^990000iro.ragnarokonline.com^000000，說能幫你學到該懂的東西。

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Of course, I don't know what the heck it means, but if you understand it, it'll probably help you out a lot.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
當然，我也不知道那玩意兒到底是什麼。
不過你要是懂，大概能幫上不少忙。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Whoa, slow down newbie. We only accept people who are at least Thief Job Level 40. I ain't risking myself by letting you in before you're ready. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[流氓公會成員]
Whoa，先別急，新來的。
我們只收盜賊職業等級至少40的人。
你還沒準備好，我可不敢冒險放你進來。
懂了？

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Huh...?
What's an Assassin doin' here? Uh, you haven't been assigned to kill someone in the Rogue Guild, are you?
scripts.translation:
[流氓公會成員]
嗯...？
刺客來這裡幹什麼？
呃，你該不會是奉命來殺我們公會裡誰的吧？

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
In any case, don't mess with us! You can't catch me... I'm a smooth criminal!
scripts.translation:
[流氓公會成員]
總之，別惹我們！
你抓不住我...我可是個身手利落的慣犯！

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Don't get it, huh? It's something I always used to say to Huey. If you're in the Assassin Guild, you oughta have met him...
scripts.translation:
[流氓公會成員]
沒聽懂？
這是我以前常對休伊說的話。
你在刺客公會，應該見過他吧...

scripts.text:
[Markie]
Hey hey~
Long time no see.
Eh, right now we don't
any requests from the
guild for you, so just
check back again later.
scripts.translation:
[馬基]
Hey hey~
好久不見。
公會現在沒任務給你，過陣子再來看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Rogue Guildsman]
Hey you...
Get your ugly
ass out of here
before I redecorate
that face of yours!
scripts.translation:
[流氓公會成員]
喂，你...
趕緊滾出去，不然老子就把你那張臉揍得改頭換面！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Welcome to
the Rogue guild.
From here on, I will
verify your qualification.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
歡迎來到流氓公會。
接下來，由我檢驗你的資格。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Before we get started,
I want you to know
about something...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
開始之前，先告訴你一件事...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
All new Rogues are required to pay an application fee, so I hope you take care of that first.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
所有新加入的流氓都得交報名費，希望你先把這事辦好。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What you have to understand is that the Rogue Guild does a lot of business, ^666666sometimes illegally^000000, that needs financial backup.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
你得明白，流氓公會有很多生意，^666666有時候不太合法^000000，都需要資金支援。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I will let you know...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
我會告訴你的...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I will let you know......
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
我會告訴你的...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I will let you know........
By the way.....
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
我會告訴你的...
順便說一下...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Oh man...
This is...
Damn...
Annoying!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
真是的...
這...
該死...
煩死了！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Today, I'm in a pissed off mood, ya' know why?! I haven't collected any bills! God! Idiot Thieves coming at me all the time, wanting to become Rogues!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
今天老子火大，知道為什麼嗎？！
一筆錢都沒收上來！
該死！
那些蠢盜賊還一個接一個地跑來，說要當流氓！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Jesus! Now I understand why our leader told us that working as customer support sucks.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
天哪！
現在我算懂了，為什麼首領說做客服真他媽難受。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
That god damn guild master assigned me to this shitty job. I'm better than this F$@king job!
That bastard should go to F$@king hell, I'm gonna kick that mother F$@kers ass! F#%k F#%k F#%k !!!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
那個該死的會長把這破差事丟給我。
老子的本事，哪該幹這F$@king破活！
讓那混蛋下F$@king地獄去吧，老子要踹爛那個F$@kers的屁股！
F#%k F#%k F#%k !!!

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
That dipshit who just tried to change his job, the one before you...
You know what the f#@k he talked to me about?!?
F#$@%#$*#$%@#$!!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
你前面那個來轉職的蠢貨...
你知道他跟我扯了什麼f#@k玩意兒嗎？！
F#$@%#$*#$%@#$!!

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What the--?! What's with this chat filter?! Stop #*!@$ing me! you stupid F#$%*! Let me talk!!!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什麼——？！
這聊天過濾器搞什麼鬼？！
別再#*!@$ing我了！
你這蠢F#$%*！
讓我說話！！！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What the f#@k you looking at...? {0}? That's your name!?
 
[{1}]
Umm...
Sir...?
I didn't mean to make you upset. I just came here to so I could become a Rogue.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
你他f#@k看什麼...？
{0}？你叫這個名字？！
 
[{1}]
呃...
先生...？
我不是故意惹你生氣的。
我只是來轉職成流氓。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Holy shit on a stick, what the f#$k was I just f!#king talking about, you moron!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
他媽的，老子剛才說了什麼f#$k話啊，你這蠢貨！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Just leave me alone! Just leave alone! Just leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
別煩我！
別煩我！
別煩我！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Do whatever you want, okay? Just do whatever the F$!!K you want...!!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
愛幹什麼就幹什麼，行了吧？
你他F$!!K愛怎麼著就怎麼著...！！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Crysalis^000000!
^FF00005 Empty Bottle^000000!
^FF00005 Iron Ore^000000!
^FF00005 Stone Heart^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Red Herb^000000!
^FF00005 Animal Skin^000000!!
^FF00005 Yellow Gemstone^000000!!

^FF00005 Yoyo Tail^000000!!

^FF00005 Feather of Birds^000000!
^FF00005 Talon^000000!!
^FF00005 Spawn^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
Don't even think about coming back until you've got all those or I'll kill you where you stand.
scripts.translation:

沒把這些東西都弄齊之前，別想回來，否則我就把你當場殺掉。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What the F$@k? Did you just say I'm annoying you? Shut up, you ungrateful prick!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什麼F$@k？
你說我煩你？
閉嘴，你這不知好歹的混蛋！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I just added ^FF000010 Raccoon Leaf^000000 to the list. You better get it!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
清單上再加^FF000010片變身葉子^000000。
最好給我弄齊！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
F%$#*&#@$%#@$@#$%@$%&*k! Haven't you ever thought about how hard it would be to be an NPC!?!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
F%$#*&#@$%#@$@#$%@$%&*k! 你想過當 NPC 有多難嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Three thousand, two hundred seventy two. Three thousand, two hundred seventy three. Three thousand, two hundred seventy four...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
三千二百七十二。
三千二百七十三。
三千二百七十四...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Uhh...
Headache...
This is too much
zeny to count.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
呃...
頭疼...
這麼多 Zeny，數都數不完。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Uh...?
What are you doing here? If you're going to talk about the job change, you need to speak to the other guy first.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
嗯...？
你來幹什麼？
要辦轉職，先去找另一個人。

[史密斯先生]
...該死！
我數亂了！

[史密斯先生]
嗯...讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Wow, you've brought each and every single thing I asked you to. Good work... I salute you.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
哇，我要的東西你一樣不落地全帶來了。
幹得不錯...向你致敬。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Since you showed such great effort, I'm going to write a recommendation letter for you. I usually don't do that, you know.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
看你這麼賣力，我就給你寫封推薦信。
平時我可不幹這事。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
But I'm sure you'll be a great asset to the Rogue Guild. Hmm, I don't have a blank piece of paper right now, so take this instead...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
不過，你肯定能給流氓公會幫上大忙。
嗯，手頭沒空白紙，先拿這個代替吧...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
*Sigh...*
I know, I know. I'm supposed to control myself in the work place. Getting enraged is a bad habit...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
*Sigh...*
知道，知道，工作時該控制情緒。
動不動發火確實是個壞毛病...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
*Mumble mumble...*
How was I... *Mumble...*
How did... I remember...
*Sigh* It was all because of my bad temper!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
*Mumble mumble...*
我剛才怎麼... *Mumble...*
怎麼會...想起來了...
*Sigh* 都怪我這壞脾氣！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt might be a better
idea to come back later.^000000

[Mr. Smith]
Listen this time!
Application fee:
^FF000010000 zeny^000000,
^FF00005 Crysalis^000000!
^FF00005 Empty Bottle^000000!
^FF00005 Iron Ore^000000!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Stone Heart^000000!!
^FF00005 Red Herb^000000!
^FF00005 Animal Skin^000000!!
^FF00005 Yellow Gemstone^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Tooth of Bat^000000!
^FF00005 Scorpion Tail^000000!!
^FF00005 Yoyo Tail^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
^FF00005 Feather of Birds^000000!
^FF00005 Talon^000000!!
^FF00005 Spawn^000000!!
^FF000010 Raccoon Leaf^000000!!

[Mr. Smith]
Don't even think
of coming back
without them!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
沒帶齊就別想回來！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Let me see...
Who would should
I send you to...?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
讓我想想...
該讓你去找誰呢...？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Right! I know
just the guy~!
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
對了！
我知道該找誰了~！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Go visit Aragham Junior who lives South of the Sandarman Fortress. That area is located one field east from here.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
去找住在桑達曼要塞南邊的小阿拉甘。
從這裡往東走一個地圖，就是那一帶。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
He's a pretty nice guy, you know. He works hard and is really good at bill collecting.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
他人挺不錯，幹活賣力，收債也很在行。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Before he joined the Rogue Guild, people have been trying to kill him for something his father did in the past. So, he became a runaway.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
他父親以前做過些事，惹得人們一直追殺他，他只好四處逃亡。
那是在他加入流氓公會之前。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Well anyway, that's why he's been with us. We've been helping him hide from his enemies.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
總之，他就是這樣加入我們的。
我們一直幫他躲避仇家。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Ah, you might want to remember the password if you want to meet him. He doesn't let anybody in his house without the password.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
想見他，最好記住暗號。
說不出暗號，他不會讓任何人進門。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
The password is ^0000FFAragham never hoarded upgrade items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
暗號是^0000FFAragham never hoarded upgrade items^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Well, I will wish you luck. His place isn't that far from here, so come back as soon as possible. Being swift... That is the spirit of the Rogue.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
祝你好運。
他住得不遠，儘快回來。
行動迅速...這就是流氓的精神。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Hmm...
This guy might be
good for you, but...
He's a little dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
嗯...
這個人也許適合教你，不過...
他有點危險。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I want you to meet Antonio Junior, son of Antonio the first. For some reason people have been trying to kill him because of something his father did in the past.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
去找小安東尼奧，他是老安東尼奧的兒子。
他父親以前做過些事，不知為何一直有人因此想殺他。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
He was brought up in Payon, but he's staying in an empty house near the Kokomo beach at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
他是在斐揚長大的，但現在住在剋剋魔海邊的一棟空房子裡。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
I've heard lately that he's been complaining a lot about the noise outside of his house, and he fears an assassination attempt. Anyway...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
最近聽說，他總抱怨屋外太吵，還擔心有人要暗殺他。
總之...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
He's kind of tense, so he throws a dagger at anyone who approaches his house. He has a violent personality.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
他神經緊繃，誰靠近他家，他就朝誰扔短劍。
脾氣挺暴躁。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
However, he does have magnificent business skills. And he also loves gambling. Once you get to know him, he'll take care of your Rogue training really well.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
不過，他做生意很有本事，也喜歡賭博。
等熟悉了，他會好好指導你的流氓訓練。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Ah, you might want to remember the password to meet him in person. The password is ^0000FFAntonio doesn't enjoy destroying upgrade items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
想當面見他，最好記住暗號。
暗號是^0000FFAntonio doesn't enjoy destroying upgrade items^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Hmm...
This guy might be
good for you, but...
He's a little dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
嗯...
這個人也許適合教你，不過...
他有點危險。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
His name is
Hollgrehenn Junior,
a genius at manipulation.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
他叫小霍爾格雷恩，是個操縱人心的天才。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
However, because of something his father did long ago, people have been trying to kill him. Because of this, he is very high strung and will throw daggers at people he doesn't trust.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
不過，他父親以前做過些事，一直有人因此追殺他。
所以他神經特別緊繃，會朝不信任的人扔短劍。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Our leader has been able to get him to join our guild, and his brilliant mind has been an asset to us. Once you get to know him, he'll take care of your Rogue training really well.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
首領成功說服他加入公會，他的聰明才智幫了我們不少忙。
等熟悉了，他會好好指導你的流氓訓練。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Ah, you might want to remember the password to meet him in person. The password is ^0000FFMy father never hoarded upgrade items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
想當面見他，最好記住暗號。
暗號是^0000FFMy father never hoarded upgrade items^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Alright... Now that I've calmed down, I can inform you of your next destination. *Whew*
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
好...
現在我冷靜下來了，可以告訴你接下來該去哪了。
*Whew*

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Go and find Hermanthorn Junior, who is living near the ^0000FFthe checkpoint of Paros Lighthouse^000000, which is at the border between Morocc and Comodo.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
去找小赫曼索恩。
他住在^0000FF帕羅斯燈塔檢查站^000000附近，就在夢羅克與克魔島的交界處。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Ah...almost forgot, keep in mind not to mention anything about upgrading items. This is very important.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
啊...差點忘了，千萬別提精煉物品的事。
這點很重要。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What...?
Did you just
say that you
forgot where to go?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什麼...？
你說忘了該去哪？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Head one field East and enter the building that is South of the Sandarman Fortress to meet Aragham Junior.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
往東走一個地圖，進入桑達曼要塞南邊的房子，找小阿拉甘。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
The password is ^0000FFAragham never hoarded upgrade items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
暗號是^0000FFAragham never hoarded upgrade items^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What...?
Did you just
say that you
forgot where to go?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什麼...？
你說忘了該去哪？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Go to the building
at Kokomo Beach,
which is on the way
to Comodo, to meet
Antonio Junior.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
去剋剋魔海邊的房子找小安東尼奧。
那裡就在去克魔島的路上。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
The password is ^0000FF'Antonio doesn't enjoy destroying upgrade items'^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
暗號是^0000FF'Antonio doesn't enjoy destroying upgrade items'^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What...?
Did you just
say that you
forgot where to go?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什麼...？
你說忘了該去哪？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Go to the field South of Sandarman Fortress, which is on the way to Morocc from here, to meet Hollgrehenn Junior.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
去桑達曼要塞南邊的野外找小霍爾格雷恩。
那裡在從這裡前往夢羅克的路上。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
The password is ^0000FFMy father never hoarded upgrade items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
暗號是^0000FFMy father never hoarded upgrade items^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Hmmm...?
Don't you have
to go somewhere
else to complete
your Rogue training?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
嗯...？
你不是還得去別處完成流氓訓練嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
First, the
application fee:
^FF000010,000 zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
首先，報名費：
^FF000010,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Hmm...?
What was that?
Did you just say that
you're willing to donate
more for the guild?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
嗯...？
你說什麼？
願意多給公會捐點？

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
That sounds sweet,
I appreciate that.
But come back when
you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
那可真不錯，多謝了。
不過，還是等你準備好再來。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Okay, we've got the application fee, ^FF000010,000 zeny^000000, {0} {1}, {2} {3}, {4} {5} and {6} {7}...

[Mr. Smith]
Great, great...
I think you
brought everything.
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
很好，很好...
看來都帶齊了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Alright, wait just a moment while
I prepare these things. Let's see... Your next test is...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
好，稍等，我先把這些東西處理好。
讓我看看...你的下一項考核是...

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
What the f$@k!? You didn't bring all the required items?! Are you telling me that you need to check the requirements again!?
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
什麼f$@k？！
你沒把東西帶齊？！
還要再核對一次要求，是吧？！

scripts.text:
[Mr. Smith]
Now listen...!
Bring ^FF000010,000 zeny^000000,
and the following items...
scripts.translation:
[史密斯先生]
聽好了...！
帶來^FF000010,000 Zeny^000000，還有以下物品...

scripts.text:
[???]
Who's there?!
Who would dare
intrude my territory?
scripts.translation:
[???]
誰在那兒？！
誰敢闖我的地盤？

scripts.text:
[???]
Who's there?!
Who would dare
intrude my territory?
scripts.translation:
[???]
誰在那兒？！
誰敢闖我的地盤？

scripts.text:
[???]
Who's there?!
Who would dare
intrude my territory?
scripts.translation:
[???]
誰在那兒？！
誰敢闖我的地盤？

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
I see...
You must be from
the Rogue guild.
You must be one of the
ones Mr. Smith wasn't
too happy with...
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
原來如此...
你是流氓公會派來的吧。
看來也是讓史密斯先生不太滿意的人之一...

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
He threw a fit and you brought him all the items he asked for, didn't you? Well, I can see that you're still pretty naive. Hahaha~
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
他發了頓脾氣，你就把要的東西全給他弄來了，是吧？
看來你還真夠天真的。
Hahaha~

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
I suppose he suckered you into gathering those items, and then passed you on to me. Sad, really.
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
他騙你收集完那些東西，就把你推給我了吧。
真可憐。

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
Well, since you were tortured by him, I'll try to be especially generous to you. My test for you will be simple, so simple.
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
既然你已經被他折騰過，我就格外寬容些。
給你的考核很簡單，特別簡單。

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
All you have to do is go through an underground tunnel, and walk all the way back to the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
只要穿過地下隧道，一路走回流氓公會就行。

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
There is one thing I should tell you, though. You might want to be careful inside, alright?
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
不過有件事得提醒你。
在裡面小心點，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
A bunch of pricks have been throwing Dead Branches and casting Hocus Pocus all over the place...
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
一群混蛋在裡面到處折枯樹枝、施放隨機技能...

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
Well...
Just make it back to the Rogue Guild alive. That's all you have to do!
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
總之...
活著回到流氓公會，就算過關！

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
Oh right. This is really important. You need a password to enter the tunnel. To unlock the door, the four number combination is ^0000FF3019^000000.
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
哦，對了，這點很重要。
進隧道得輸密碼，開門的四位數字是^0000FF3019^000000。

scripts.text:
[HermanthornJr.]
Huh...?
What the hell
are you doing here.
Scram, why don't you?
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
嗯...？
你他媽在這裡幹什麼？
還不快滾？

scripts.text: ^3355FFThe door is locked. You'll need to enter the four number combination to open it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF門鎖著。輸入四位數字密碼才能開啟。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFIt didn't work. Please re-enter the four number combination.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF密碼不對。請重新輸入四位數字密碼。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFPlease enter a combination of four numbers.^000000

[HermanthornJr.]
Well...
Didn't I tell you
that I changed the
password? *Wink Wink*
scripts.translation:
[小 赫曼索恩]
哎呀...
我沒告訴你密碼改了嗎？
*Wink Wink*

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Oh, you must be
from the Rogue Guild...
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
哦，你是流氓公會派來的吧...

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
My name is
Aragham Junior,
Rogue of the Desert.
Are you ready to learn
how to be a Rogue?
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
我叫小阿拉甘，人稱沙漠流氓。
準備好學習流氓的本領了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
See, as a Rogue, our motto is, '^0000FFAvoid the strong! Be malicious to the weak!^000000' That rule especially goes true for monsters.
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
聽著，流氓的座右銘就是“^0000FF避開強者！欺凌弱者！^000000”
對付魔物時尤其如此。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Avoid the strong!
Be malicious to the weak!
It's a simple rule...
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
避開強者！
欺凌弱者！
規矩就這麼簡單...

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Now, remember it as you go through ^0000FFthe Underground Tunnel^000000. Try to walk all the way to the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
穿過^0000FF地下隧道^000000時，把這話記牢。
試著一路走回流氓公會。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
There will be a few monsters, but don't worry. I know you're strong. Alright, are you ready to go or what?
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
裡面有些魔物，不過別擔心，我知道你有本事。
好了，準備出發沒有？

[小 阿拉甘]
好的...
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Fine, fine.
Take your time
and come back
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
好，好。
慢慢準備，好了再來。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Oh, you're back.
I think you'll do well this time. Another motto Rogues have is '^0000FFFailure teaches success^000000.' Well, then again...
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
哦，回來了。
這次應該能做好吧。
流氓還有句座右銘：“^0000FF失敗乃成功之母^000000”。
不過，話又說回來...

[小 阿拉甘]
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Fine, fine.
Take your time
and come back
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
好，好。
慢慢準備，好了再來。

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Huh...?
Who are you?!
You're not from
the Rogue Guild!!
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
嗯...？
你是誰？！
你不是流氓公會的人！！

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
You've come here to kill me, haven't you? N-no! I'm can't die yet! Get lost! Otherwise, I'll kill you first!
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
你是來殺我的，對不對？
不、不行！
我還不能死！
滾開，不然我先殺了你！

scripts.text:
[Aragham Jr.]
Hey...
what brings
you back here?
Why don't you
take a rest
before you leave?
scripts.translation:
[小 阿拉甘]
嘿...
怎麼又回來了？
走之前不休息一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Huh...
From the
Rogue guild, huh?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍爾格雷恩]
嗯...
流氓公會派來的？

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
I'm Hollgrehenn Junior. I tend to a lot of our underground business. So are you ready to take on my test?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍爾格雷恩]
我是小霍爾格雷恩，負責不少地下生意。
準備好接受我的考核了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
We Rogues share this motto: ^0000FFAvoid the strong! Be malicious to the weak!^000000 This rule applies to any threat, especially monsters.
scripts.translation:
[小 霍爾格雷恩]
我們流氓的座右銘是：^0000FF避開強者！欺凌弱者！^000000
對付任何威脅都適用，尤其是魔物。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
It's easy to remember.
Just don't forget to put it into practice. You got it?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍爾格雷恩]
很好記吧。
別忘了照著做，明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
For my test, you'll go through the ^0000FFUnderground Tunnel^000000. Follow it all the way back to the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[小 霍爾格雷恩]
我的考核是讓你穿過^0000FF地下隧道^000000，沿路走回流氓公會。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
There are some monsters there, but that'll be part of your training. Now, are you ready to go or not?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍爾格雷恩]
裡面有些魔物，不過這也是訓練的一部分。
現在，準備出發沒有？

[小 霍爾格雷恩]
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Take your time.
Come back here
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[小 霍爾格雷恩]
慢慢準備。
準備好了再來。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Huh.
You failed.
Gonna try again?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍爾格雷恩]
嗯。
沒通過啊。
要再試一次嗎？

[小 霍爾格雷恩]
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Take your time.
Come back here
when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[小 霍爾格雷恩]
慢慢準備。
準備好了再來。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Huh...?
You're not from
the Rogue Guild...
scripts.translation:
[小 霍爾格雷恩]
嗯...？
你不是流氓公會的人...

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
You better get out
of here right now
if you know what's
good for you...
scripts.translation:
[小 霍爾格雷恩]
識相的話，就趕緊滾出去...

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Now...
Beat it before
I change my mind
about killing you.
scripts.translation:
[小 霍爾格雷恩]
現在...
趁我還沒改主意殺你，趕緊滾。

scripts.text:
[Hollgrehenn Jr.]
Hey...
Come to visit?
We Rogues gotta
stick together, huh?
scripts.translation:
[小 霍爾格雷恩]
嘿...
來看我的？
我們流氓得互相照應，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
You're from
the Rogue guild?
If you wanna learn
about becoming a Rogue,
then shut up and stay put.
scripts.translation:
[小 安東尼奧]
流氓公會來的？
想學流氓的本領，就閉嘴待好。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
^0000FFAvoid the strong! Be malicious to the weak!^000000 That's our motto for battling monsters.
scripts.translation:
[小 安東尼奧]
^0000FF避開強者！欺凌弱者！^000000
這就是我們對付魔物的座右銘。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
Show no mercy when you fight weaker monsters, and try to keep away from stronger monsters.
scripts.translation:
[小 安東尼奧]
對弱小的魔物別留情，對強大的魔物則儘量避開。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
Now, I want you to walk all the way to the Rogue Guild through this ^0000FFUnderground Tunnel^000000.
scripts.translation:
[小 安東尼奧]
現在，穿過這條^0000FF地下隧道^000000，一路走回流氓公會。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
There are monsters there, but if you avoid the strong and be malicious to the weak, you'll be fine.
scripts.translation:
[小 安東尼奧]
裡面有魔物，不過只要避開強者、欺凌弱者，就不會有事。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
I hope you do
not fail this test
You can only become
a Rogue if you pass...
scripts.translation:
[小 安東尼奧]
希望你別搞砸。
只有通過考核，才能成為流氓...

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
I don't have time
to fool around with
you. Hurry up, get
ready, then take
the test.
scripts.translation:
[小 安東尼奧]
我沒空跟你耗。
趕緊準備，參加考核。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
You failed...?
I guess that's life.
Are you gonna try
again or what?
scripts.translation:
[小 安東尼奧]
沒通過...？
人生就是這樣吧。
還要再試一次嗎？

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
Remember, I'm doing
you a favor here...
Now, don't come back
until you're a Rogue.
scripts.translation:
[小 安東尼奧]
記住，我這可是在幫你...
沒當上流氓，就別回來。

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
I don't have time
to fool around with
you. Hurry up, get
ready, then take
the test.
scripts.translation:
[小 安東尼奧]
我沒空跟你耗。
趕緊準備，參加考核。

scripts.text:
Huh...?
Who are you?!
You're not from
the Rogue Guild!!
scripts.translation:
嗯...？
你是誰？！
你不是流氓公會的人！！

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
You've come here to kill me?! I won't let you!! Come on, give me your best shot! You can't fight if I rip out your eyes!
scripts.translation:
[小 安東尼奧]
你是來殺我的？！
休想！！
來啊，有本事就動手！
挖掉你的眼睛，看你還怎麼打！

scripts.text:
[Antonio Jr.]
Hey, how's it goin'?
Take it easy, and just
relax before you leave.
scripts.translation:
[小 安東尼奧]
嘿，最近怎麼樣？
放輕鬆，走之前休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
^F08080Tah dah~
Monsters for the
Rogue Job Change
have been reset^000000.
scripts.translation:
^F08080Tah dah~
流氓轉職考核的魔物已重置^000000。
